create_AverageMeter: create an AverageMeter instance to track average and current values during model validation
run_accuracy: run the accuracy function to compute precision at k for model output against target labels
run_validate: run the validate function to evaluate a model on a validation data loader with optional FPGA and reference model
create_make_loader: create a PyTorch DataLoader for ImageNet validation data with standard image preprocessing transforms
run_sample_loader: run sample_loader to extract a single batch of input and target tensors from a DataLoader
